item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya does a light experiment at home in Jaipur. She shines a torch beam onto a small mirror lying flat on a sheet of white cardboard and marks the reflected beam on the sheet.
Her brother bends the cardboard and says the reflected beam, the incident beam and the normal can now lie in different planes.
Which statement is correct?

options.A: The incident ray, the normal and the reflected ray must always lie in the same plane.
options.B: The incident ray, the normal and the reflected ray lie in the same plane only when the sheet is flat.
options.C: The incident ray and the reflected ray lie in the same plane, but the normal may lie in a different plane.
options.D: The three lines never lie in one plane because light travels in straight lines.
